senses.gloss: m. (read אכסנופרוכא Xenoparochus) one who provides for strangers or soldiers, quartermaster.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 3:1:4">Y. B. Kam. III, 3ᶜ</cite> top <he>ההן א׳ פ׳ … שרי למיחשדוניה וכ׳</he> (read <he>למישחדוניה</he>) it is permissible to bribe the quartermaster (to let you off) before the Romans enter (the place), but not after that (when one man’s release from quartering duty is a direct injury to the other inhabitants).
